moment: The gang camp at sunset: horses at the hitching rail, covered wagon, tents, stew pot over the fire
why: Hitching rail with saddled horses, prairie schooner, wall tents and a cook pot by a mountain lake is the Van der Linde camp almost exactly.

moment: Wanted posters nailed to a board outside a frontier building
why: Aged posters tacked to weathered planks with a dusty street behind read as the RDR wanted board; also generic western.

moment: Port Royal harbour by moonlight; treasure route from Jack's compass to X past a skull medallion
why: Colonial harbour with tall ships at night plus compass, dotted route, X and skull token.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal page with a crossed-out sketch, red pencil underline
why: Pencil-sketched horse, pines and lake on cream paper with a taped note is the RDR2 journal look.

moment: Sunrise over a river valley with a horse grazing under an oak
why: Painterly golden-hour western vista with a lone horse fits RDR2 scenery, but nothing specific pins it.

moment: Floating candles under the enchanted ceiling, one candle locked in a teal reticle
why: Hovering candles in a starry dark read as the Great Hall ceiling; the bracket is a game-UI overlay.

moment: Candles in a night sky with broom-tail streaks
why: Floating candles plus bristled line ends that look like brooms in flight.

moment: Golden-hour valley and grazing horse, framed as a card
why: Same vista as J005; generic western.

moment: Hogwarts Express on the Glenfinnan Viaduct
why: Red steam engine on the curved Highland viaduct beside a loch.

moment: Wanted-poster board, blank poster in front
why: Same as J002.

moment: College lecture hall, quadcopter and a formula sketched on the board
why: Exposed-stone and concrete-colonnade Indian campus lecture theatre with a chalk drone fits the 3 Idiots college and its drone subplot.

moment: Black Pearl's hull behind a gold-ruled treasure chart (island outline, X, waypoint line)
why: Tattered black-sailed galleon plus an X-marks-the-spot chart.

moment: Black Pearl in shadow, Jack's compass above a dotted route
why: Black-sailed ship silhouette plus the octagonal brass compass.

moment: Virus's astronaut pen in its velvet case beside his stopwatch
why: Ceremonial pen in a box next to a pocket watch in a classroom matches the director's pen and his obsession with time; would not land with someone who hasn't seen the film.

moment: Virus's pen and stopwatch, slightly closer
why: Same as J014.

moment: Night camp, two tents around a fire
why: Frontier campfire mood; generic on its own.

moment: The Marauder's Map on a candlelit floor, footprints walking across it
why: Moving footprints on parchment under floating candles with a castle window.

moment: Night sea, tall ship on the horizon, Jack's compass in the swell
why: Square-rigger plus brass compass; the glowing teal wave also nods to Sea of Thieves.

moment: Hogwarts across the Black Lake at night, broomstick and floating candles
why: Spired castle on a cliff over black water, a broom and candles.

moment: Ship sailing into the sunset with a glowing wake; compass-to-X treasure route
why: Dotted treasure route, X, skull token and Jack's compass.

moment: The Great Hall's enchanted ceiling: floating candles under clouds and stars
why: Candles hovering beneath a night sky with drifting cloud is the enchanted ceiling.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: ladder/rail sketch, horse, lake, taped note
why: Same journal style as J004.

moment: Classroom blackboard with a bar chart and a drone sketch, sunlit arched window
why: The chalk drone points to 3 Idiots, but the Romanesque window could equally be a Hogwarts classroom; weak.

moment: Camp at dusk: canvas tent with a lantern, pot over the fire, wagon
why: Wall tent, chuck wagon and tripod pot against the Rockies evoke the gang camp.

moment: Night sea with a glowing wave, ship on the horizon, compass
why: Same as J018.

moment: Pangong Lake, Ladakh: the yellow scooter on the shore
why: Mirror-still high-altitude lake, bare brown mountains and a lone yellow scooter: the 3 Idiots ending postcard.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolding, footprints appearing near the title banner
why: Folded parchment, compass-rose seals, a banner and wandering ink footprints.

moment: Empty lecture hall, quadcopter drawn on the board
why: Same lecture hall as J011.

moment: Storm at sea; compass-to-X treasure route past a skull
why: Same map motif as J020 with a storm.

moment: The Black Pearl by moonlight with Jack's compass
why: Ragged black sails, lantern-lit stern and the brass compass.

moment: The Great Hall with hundreds of floating candles
why: House tables, staff table, gothic windows, floating candles.

moment: Blood-red sunset over a homestead; a line of Dead Eye marks across the grass
why: Crimson-graded ranch, oak, crows and pink X tags along a path read as Red Dead / Dead Eye.

moment: The Black Pearl emerging from fog; dotted route to an X on the water
why: Black Pearl silhouette plus the X-marks-the-spot route.

moment: The Marauder's Map: footprints walking the corridors, broom marks
why: Ink footprints moving along hand-drawn corridors on folded parchment.

moment: Dead Eye: red sky over the ranch with X marks on the crows
why: Red-tinted landscape plus X tags on birds is a direct Dead Eye reference.

moment: Homemade quadcopter flying across the college courtyard
why: Exposed-brick, concrete Indian campus and a DIY drone recall the 3 Idiots drone; could equally be just a real student project photo.

moment: Quadcopter hovering past the campus colonnade
why: Same as J036.

moment: The Great Hall, empty, candles lit
why: Same Great Hall composition.

moment: Pangong Lake at sunset, yellow scooter circled and ticked
why: Same postcard as J026; the circle-and-tick marks it as the destination.
